name: manual_074402
claim: Check whether a PR is already merged before reviewing or fixing it. A push to a branch after its PR merged does NOT update the base branch, so read the merged state from main, then extend an appropriate still-open PR or open a new PR from a fresh branch off main; do not push further commits to the merged branch expecting them to reach main.

decisions.notes: Corrects the false claim that a push to a merged branch lands on main; preserves the accurate workflow of reading merged state from main and extending an open PR or opening a new one.

rationale: Corrects the false claim that a push to a merged branch lands on main; preserves the accurate workflow of reading merged state from main and extending an open PR or opening a new one.
